markdown.content: ## Below panels contains HTTP's non aggregation logs (Only Global Time Filter will be applicable)
## Below panels contains HTTP's aggregation logs (Only Global Time Filter will be applicable)

dashboardQueries.name: 6d9ad7c6-79f4-4251-bc80-2accbf401546
dashboardQueries.query:
metadata.vendor_name="Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "http" OR metadata.product_event_type = "http_red" OR metadata.product_event_type = "http_agg"
$host_header=target.hostname
$host_header!=""
$combined_fields=strings.concat(metadata.ingestion_labels.value, target.ip, principal.ip)
match:
    $host_header
outcome:
    $count=count_distinct($combined_fields)
order:
    $count asc 
limit:
    20
